what: A dome (WebGL) where the camera sits at the center of a ring of twelve photo panels (radius 15.2), looking outward. Slots split the ring into twelve and stagger the height in three tiers (raised panels are pulled down by .8), so every panel faces the center. Wheel and push turn the whole orbit as if turning your head (wheel deltaY × .18 is added to a velocity of ±180, damped by .92 every frame at 60fps, orbit sensitivity .253). Panels bend along a cos curve by vertical distance, and the faster the spin, the more the center stretches. Slots that leave the screen are swapped for the next work image, so more than twelve works cycle through. On reveal, starting from the top slot at .045s intervals, panels rise from 1.25 below, .45 back and .92 scale with .69s power3.out as they appear

options.plane-h: Panel height, default 8.1 — width follows the ratio, 5.6~9.9, both ×.94
options.pull: Pull-down of the raised panel, default .8
options.start: auto (reveals as soon as attached, default) · event (panel fx:reveal { t } When it comes — if running About first)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One work (hidden) — data-ratio · data-label · data-tone=dark|mid · data-video · data-href (click to navigate)
